title: Jeff Bezos's Spaceport: Ranch deal built Blue Origin base; space tourism costs stay high
content: Jeff Bezos acquired 165,000 acres of land in West Texas to develop Blue Origin's spaceflight operations. The company launched its first crewed flight on July 20, 2021, with four passengers aboard. This historic mission marked significant milestones in commercial space travel and the efforts to expand human access to space. Blue Origin aims to make space travel available for more people beyond government programs.

title: Tyler Perry turned 330-acre former Army base into major Atlanta film studio
content: In 2015, Tyler Perry acquired the former Fort McPherson Army base in Atlanta for $30 million, and transformed it into a major production hub featuring 12 sound stages. This initiative not only aims to create new jobs but also emphasizes the importance of preserving historical structures while meeting the evolving demands of the film industry. Perry’s vision includes nurturing local talent to foster growth in South Atlanta's creative landscape.

title: Meet Aryash Shyam, 14, Indian-American student who won $1,000 writing prize
content: Indian-American student Aryash Shyam, 14, has won a $1,000 national writing prize for his historical-fiction story set in a Philadelphia print shop on July 4, 1776. The Pennsylvania ninth-grader was among four middle-school winners of the 2026 John Estey Student Writing Competition. He has also earned recognition for projects involving space research, artificial intelligence and robotics.

title: Australian homeowner wins A$6,253.50 after neighbour’s bamboo blocked sewer
content: In a landmark decision, an Australian court addressed a bamboo dispute affecting two neighboring properties in New South Wales. The court determined that the bamboo created a blockage and posed a risk for future damage to the sewer line. As a result, Homes NSW was ordered to compensate A$6,253.50 for previous treatment costs. The ruling highlights the importance of communication and diligent records for homeowners facing similar issues.

title: US ends 540-day grace period for immigrants after work authorisation expires
content: In a significant policy shift, the US Department of Homeland Security has abolished the 540-day automatic extension for work permits. This development results in immediate loss of work authorization for many, particularly affecting H-4 visa holders and asylum seekers, even while their renewal applications are pending. Moreover, the USCIS continues to face notable delays in processing these renewals, leading to a legal challenge from impacted parties contesting the new regulation.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ Volunteer for 15 program promotes youth community service.

Several young people have contributed countless hours and raised millions over the past four years. The kids learn about people from different background, racial equity, and environmental disasters. They spend more time in community service.

title: Travis Kelce's 87 Running Foundation helps rebuild former athlete's 56-year-old home

The trial included the testimony of 22 witnesses and numerous hearings over 18 months. Rajput’s mother expressed her gratitude for the verdict, hoping it deters future crimes. Both convicts were sentenced after their trial concluded on Wednesday.

title: Shai Hope scripts history, surpasses Chris Gayle in major T20I milestone for West Indies
content: In an explosive performance, Shai Hope delivered an unbeaten 102 from just 50 balls during the fourth T20I against India, becoming the first player from the West Indies to notch three T20I centuries. His outstanding innings propelled West Indies to an impressive 247/3 after 20 overs, with vital contributions from Shimron Hetmyer and Sherfane Rutherford, leaving Indian bowlers struggling to keep up with the relentless West Indies pace.

title: Child among 6 killed in small plane crash in Wisconsin; FAA, NTSB probe underway
content: Six individuals lost their lives, including a child, after a plane crash in Wisconsin Dells. The small Piper PA-46 was travelling from Kenosha to Menomonie when it went down. Weather conditions at the time are being investigated to determine their impact on the crash. Authorities received reports of the aircraft down just before 10 pm, with rescue teams finding no survivors.

title: India's WPI inflation surges to 11.39% in September on higher food, fuel prices
content: India's wholesale price index-based inflation surged to 11.39% in September due to higher food, manufactured items, and energy prices. Wholesale inflation has risen significantly amidst global commodity inflation linked to the ongoing West Asia conflict. The rising costs have impacted various aspects of the economy, including the manufacturing sector and consumer prices. Retail inflation also increased to 5.54%, marking its highest level in 23 months.

title: 700 supermarkets hit, millions lost: France warns refrigeration cyberattacks may persist
content: A cyberattack targeting refrigeration systems at supermarkets in France has led to significant disruptions in food supply chains. The attack, which occurred on Monday, affected approximately 700 supermarkets, causing spoilage and financial losses. Authorities warn that the cyber threats might still be active, urging retailers to enhance their security measures. Investigations are ongoing, but no group has claimed responsibility for these incidents.

title: 'Few things to work on': Mandhana flags improvement areas ahead of Champions Trophy

Aimed at refining their skills for the Women's Champions Trophy in February 2027, Mandhana emphasized the significance of learning from competitors and establishing solid team standards. She shared insights on their successes and highlighted aspects needing improvement.

title: New York mayor pauses plan to loosen demolition rules for historic buildings
content: Saratoga Springs Mayor John Safford has paused changes to historic building demolition rules following community backlash. Opposition arose during a public hearing where residents and preservationists expressed their concerns. The current demolition safeguards will remain while the city reviews its development regulations. Safford intends to revise other parts of the development rules despite the current pause. A City Council public hearing is scheduled, allowing further community input on proposed amendments.

title: Pierre Cardin restored ruined Provence château into music and theatre venue

This historic castle, once associated with the Marquis de Sade, is now a vibrant performing arts hub, hosting the annual Festival de Lacoste. This festival showcases opera, dance, and classical theatre in an enchanting open-air amphitheatre.

title: Selena Gomez’s Rare Impact Fund has raised over $30m, reaches 3.5m youth a year

Having already generated over $30 million, the fund collaborates with 30 nonprofits on five continents. Its goal is to raise $100 million to broaden mental health care accessibility. Recent events have gained traction, drawing support from various corporations and celebrities, highlighting the need for ongoing community engagement to meet these ambitious targets.

title: India working on China ties, says Piyush Goyal
content:
India is working to develop relations with China once again, provided continuity in the engagement is warranted, geopolitical situation does not deteriorate and a fair deal is ensured, said commerce and industry minister Piyush Goyal Wednesday, adding that the "last word" on this journey is not yet scripted. "...I think we had some concerns in the past. We are working to develop the relations with China once again," said Goyal in response to a query whether China can be a part of joint ventures in critical sectors at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum. China is the second-largest trading partner for India, with bilateral trade rising nearly 8% in 2025-26 to $128 billion. Goyal also said ties between India and US remain "substantive" and "very consequential" for the world, which are poised to get better, irrespective of any changes in political thinking in both the countries. "...The relationship draws its strength from economic, political, and security imperatives.

End of Article

title: Why Munir's plan to 'split' up Pakistan may spell the end of its civilian govt
content: field marshal Asim Munir is considering a radical solution to governance problems . he is considering breaking up the country's four provinces into 12 to 15 smaller provinces . smaller units, according to the argument for restructuring, would be easier to govern . but in a country where the military has long wielded influence over civilian governments, the political question is whether they would also be easy to control .

title: ED seizes assets worth over Rs 2,000 crore of Reliance Power
content: the enforcement directorate has seized assets worth Rs 2,033 crore . the attached assets include bank balances of RPL and its shareholding in Sasan Power Limited . ED has already attached assets worth thousands of crores of the Anil Ambani group .

title: SC: Order to clear Form 6 anomaly will come October 28
content: the supreme court assured voters complaining of irregular deletion from the Delhi electoral roll that it will take care of their predicament caused by being asked to fill Form 6 . a bench of Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi proposed listing of the application for hearing on Oct 30 . the bench said that it needs to be heard earlier given that EC has set Oct 30 as the last date for correcting the dissolution .

title: ATC software glitch behind Air India false hijack scare? Probe on
content: a false hijack alert created a real scare for security agencies and the 306 people on board the flight . the plane was diverted to Jaipur as a result . it is reliably learned pilots operating the flight, AI 2030, did not squawk the code 7500 used to convey a hijack or unlawful interference .

title: After Musk’s Ambani meltdown, Rubio to visit Reliance refinery
content: the brief stopover in jamnagar is being seen through the lens of Reliance’s plans to invest in a major refinery in Texas, the first of its kind in 50 years in the US . the announcement comes days after billionaire Elon Musk’s social media jab – addressing Mukesh Ambani as PM ambani and the real boss of India – over alleged regulatory delays .

title: India & US nearing a landing point on trade deal: EAM Jaishankar
content: external affairs minister says both sides continue to iron out differences . "i think we are waiting on a few things," he says at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum . the talks have been negotiating for over 18 months . both sides have reached a point where it would be difficult to concede any further ground .

title: John Cena granted 650 wishes to critically ill children, setting world record
content: the american wrestler and actor has made time for requests handled by the Make-A-Wish Foundation, an organisation that arranges experiences for children facing serious medical conditions . by September 2022, his contribution had reached a record 650 wishes, earning him recognition from Guinness World Records .

title: Albania anti-govt protests: Students clash with cops, blaze erupts in education min
content: anti-government protests erupt in Albania’s capital, Tirana . police used tear gas and water cannons to disperse crowds . demonstrators gathered outside the education ministry, with some throwing bricks at the building . a nearby branch also caught fire, a Reuters witness said .

title: Many Indians willingly joining Russian forces, government informs SC
content: some Indians discharged from the Russian army after persistent efforts by govt and the Indian embassy . they have become untraceable, a solicitor general says . a report from the ministry of external affairs has been placed before an SC bench .

title: Pressing matters: Trump's new spokeswoman struggles on day one
content: Katie Zacharia's opening intonation of Trump achievements evoked comparisons to a malfunctioning voice assistant . she opened her mouth, made a meal of a $54 billion pipeline, confused her husband with her new boss, answered three questions from favoured media . the white house press sec’s post combines the duties of casting director and acting the job .

title: West Bengal BJP must get rid of its 'garbage': RSS magazine
content:
Unruly elements from TMC are infiltrating into BJP in Bengal and spoiling its image, RSS's Bengali weekly 'Swastika' said, advising the party to get rid of the "garbage". This comes amid allegations of BJP workers engaging in "anti-party activities" and extortions. Warning senior party functionaries of "rowdies" trying to make their way into the party, the article said, "These elements are trying to defame BJP and damage the party. They're perceiving the decency of the BJP brass and workers as their weakness." TNN

End of Article

title: US needs 1.7m skilled workers a year, but Trump's visa war risks talent crunch
content: the report estimates 24% of the skilled trades workforce is aged 55 or older . demand is also growing amid investments in data centres, energy modernisation and advanced manufacturing . the u.s. needs roughly 1.7 million new skilled workers annually through 2035 .

title: As Canada minister calls on him, PM Modi backs momentum in ties
content: foreign minister anita Anand calls on pm Narendra Modi . she also meets with her counterpart . anand says he's looking forward to continuing his engagements with the pm . he is set to visit the u.s. in december .

title: Ankita Bhandari case: 'VIP' link brings parents to India Gate; U'khand govt reacts
content: questions over alleged VIP angle have resurfaced following controversial political appointment . appointment of former BJP national general secretary prompted fresh outrage from ankita's family . parents are now protesting at India Gate in Delhi, demanding that president halt his appointment until the central bureau of investigation is complete .

title: ATC got hijack code but pilots deny: Baffling mystery behind Air India flight scare
content: a false hijack scare sent the longhaul Frankfurt-Delhi flight being diverted to jaipur . the plane was parked on a remote bay and was cleared to take off for Delhi . it was squawking transponder code 7500 which is the aviation code for hijacking .
